articles.title: Nintendo’s latest Switch 2 update adds VRR support in TV mode
articles.description: Nintendo always promised that the Switch 2 would support variable refresh rate (VRR) when docked, but the console launched without this key feature. A new 23.0.0 firmware update now adds VRR support to the Switch 2 when it's docked and in TV mode. VRR adjusts a display's refresh rate to match a game's frame rate, […]

articles.title: Xbox picks up Kojima's Physint after PlayStation dropped it
articles.description: Xbox will now publish Physint, an upcoming game from Metal Gear creator Hideo Kojima, after PlayStation decided to cancel it.
